question: For which of the following franchise teams did AB de Villiers play in IPL 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Royal Challengers Bangalore.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **AB de Villiers** is a former professional cricketer from South Africa.

 
 
• He holds the record for the fastest ODI century in just 31 balls.
 
• He played for **Royal Challengers Bangalore**__ in IPL 2020.
 
• Delhi Daredevils(now Delhi Capitals) was is his first franchise in the Indian Premier League.
 
• He moved to Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) in the league's fourth season.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The **Royal Challengers Bangalore**__ is a franchise cricket team based in Karnataka.

 __
 
• It was founded in **2008.**
 
• Royal Challengers Bangalore have **won their maiden IPL trophy in 2025.**
 
• **Rajat Patidar** is the current captain of the Royal Challengers Bangalore.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Teams that played IPL games 2020 are:
 
 
• Delhi Capitals.
 
• Royal Challengers Bangalore.
 
• Kolkata Knight Riders.
 
• Mumbai Indians.
 
• Chennai Super Kings.
 
• Punjab Kings.
 
• Rajasthan Royals.
 
• Sunrisers Hyderabad.
